controls.background: Codex and host OS active; no concurrent VM builds or tests during measurement

host_environment.transport: server and loadgen share Linux guest TCP loopback

environment.physical_core_scope: guest-visible topology when virtualized; host physical cores require host_environment
environment.thread_configuration: one Gateway io_context thread and one Matching thread; loadgen is a separate process
environment.transport: TCP loopback on the same host

quantile_method: nearest-rank, per run; completed samples only; no fixed clock-cost subtraction

definitions.counts: Measured client counts exclude setup; server counters and Reference counts include setup.
definitions.latency_ns: RTT completed at client; service/gateway internally completed measured admissions; send lag all started requests.
definitions.rate_window: Client measurement start through final completion or bounded termination, including residual schedule after connection loss.
definitions.cpu_rss: Whole server lifetime including setup; captured before evidence formatting.
definitions.range: Min/max across all five declared measured rounds, not a confidence interval.
definitions.threshold: At least 100000 completed client samples and elapsed >=10s; does not establish tail stability.

workload.notes: Setup is outside measurement. Dependencies stay within each connection's ordered stream. Cross-connection maker order may vary; verify each actual admitted trace independently. Background depth is fixed and mostly passive, not a full-book stress claim. Sweep has 64 or more adds per market sweep; whole-stream throughput is not sweep-only throughput. Actual depths and final state must come from server/reference evidence. Request loss may change business outcomes.
